citation.authors: Stuart CA, Gilkison CR, Keenan BS, Nagamani M
citation.journal: Journal of the National Medical Association

cited_by.title: Dark velvety patches on the neck and folds (acanthosis nigricans)

record.population: 89 African American people with acanthosis nigricans and 25 without
record.design: Cross-sectional study with oral glucose tolerance testing and insulin response
record.finding: Diabetes was present in 19 of those with acanthosis nigricans, reaching 50% among those in their 40s. Fasting insulin rose in direct proportion to the severity of neck involvement. The authors read the skin sign as a marker of hyperinsulinaemia and insulin resistance.
